note: Single source for the vocabulary in brain/INTERFACE.md section 0. Read by brain/meta.js, test/taxonomy.test.js and dashboard/server.js. Descriptions only: nothing here changes behavior.

reflex.lane: hooks (physicsTick, health, events); may take leases from brain/reflexes.js
reflex.desc: Automatic protection that acts in a tick or a few seconds, whatever the bot is doing: combat, drowning, safety retreat.

observer.lane: events only; never moves the bot or touches the world
observer.desc: Watches and records: lag, hurt by cause, survival lives, standing views, the dashboard.

interface.desc: Turns Walter's words into commands: exact commands, fuzzy match, decision router.

planner.lane: one scheduler task (autopilot) or a chat-lane session (manual)
planner.desc: Chooses what to do next: the think-first autopilot, the fast-tier director, the manual driver.

job.desc: A bounded piece of work with a start and an end: mine, excavate, build, farm, light, clear a box.

service.desc: Capability other modules use: navigation, crafting and finding, community plugins.

policy.desc: Decides what is allowed or on: the task or autonomous stance.

ladder.desc: One bot action with a result: dig a block, goto, place, equip, open a chest.
A named, reusable sequence of primitives the planner can pick from its menu (brain/autopilot/skills.js).
A scheduler task that owns the bot for a while and can be paused and resumed (mining, excavation, building).
A standing aim with a success test that picks jobs and skills (brain/autopilot/goals.js).
The chooser above goals: the think-first model, or the routine step list as fallback.

claims.body: walk/swim/jump controls and the pathfinder goal
claims.melee: the right to swing at mobs (exactly one melee holder at a time)
claims.hands: the held slot and block placing
claims.danger: ownership of the current danger response (seal-in, heal, re-plan)
claims.autopilot-gate: whether the autopilot may play its own goals (set by the stance policy)
